facts.fact: The National Payment Systems Act, 2015 (Act No. 4 of 2015, assented 25 April 2015, gazetted 22 May 2015) regulates payment systems, payment instruments and electronic money under Bank of Tanzania licensing, applies to Mainland Tanzania and Zanzibar, and is recorded as codified in Chapter 437, Revised Edition 2023; the commencement date is by ministerial notice and is not given in the document, so the gazette date is used.

note: Covers business licensing rules requiring proof of digital payment facilities and a mandatory electronic payments order; it states nothing on a payments law, e-money rules, non-bank licensing or provider connection.

Business Licensing (Amendment) Regulations 2026 require proof of digital payment facilities for business licences; not a payments law or e-money rule and says nothing on non-bank licensing or provider connection.
Banking regulations on Shari'ah-compliant banking windows; concern banks only and say nothing on payment providers, e-money or connection.
Consumer complaints guidelines for financial service providers; a consumer protection rule, not a payments law, and the held text says nothing on non-bank licensing or provider connection.
